title: RelayForge event envelope v1
description: Request body for POST /api/v1/events. Additional envelope properties are forbidden. The data object is tenant-defined and may be further constrained by a tenant event schema.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339. Optional; defaults to server now. Must be within configured bounds.

data.description: Business payload. Must be a JSON object. Signed as part of the raw request body, not this parsed object.
